title: Traffic Signal - New
description: Use this service request to request the installation of a brand new traffic signal where one has never existed or to request a current traffic signal be removed. The evaluation to determine addition or removal of the traffic signal is a multi-step process and may take several weeks to complete. **A name, address and daytime phone number is required. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 35 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a new or removed traffic signal.
actions.why: For installation of a signal where none existed or removal of an existing traffic signal. The 311 request form offers traffic, pedestrian, left-turn, and warning-flasher signal types and asks for the reason, time of day, and intersection; the service description says a name, address, and daytime phone number are required.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Traffic Signal - New" requests does not apply to a school-flasher sign or street light; it suggests a different service for a new traffic sign. If a school-flasher sign is needed, then submit a "Traffic Sign - New" 311 request instead. If a new traffic sign is needed, then consider submitting a "Traffic Sign - New" 311 request.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal - New"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Traffic Signal - New"

actions.tagline: Consider submitting a 311 request for a new traffic sign.
